title: Head over heels

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Gymnastics builds strength, self-esteem, confidence, concentration, and coordination. The field trip includes instructor guided exercises including warm-up, obstacles courses, trampoline and foam pits, and free play catered to the age of the group. School groups, youth groups, or adult groups can schedule special excursions in our facility to learn gymnastics skills. Field trips are scheduled through the office and are available depending on space and times available so book your field trip early to reserve your special day! Please arrive 10 minutes before the scheduled field trip time. Field Trips are required to begin and end on time as there are often other activities scheduled in the

services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Fantastic fun for your child, a piece of cake for you! We have 20,000 square feet of kid-proofed gym adventures waiting for your next big day. Your birthday bunch gets 1 hour and 30 minutes play time on the gym floor; you sit, they play, and everyone enjoys a break from the usual party planning. Trampolines, ropes, and balance beams-whether your child and their guests are brand new to gymnastics or already champion athletes, we have coaches at each party to make sure all the bouncing, balancing, and tumbling are safe and enjoyable. Because we want all participants to enjoy every aspect of your party, we recommend children wear t-shirts, sweatpants, leggings, leotards, and similar active
